inputs.text: One continuous medium shot, locked stationary camera. The same illustrated female ship captain performs a clear proud hands-on-hips gesture. At first her hands are in the reference pose. She lifts and moves both forearms, places both hands firmly on the sides of her waist, fingers resting on her hips, and opens both elbows outward. Her right hand visibly rises from the lower edge to her right hip. Her left hand slides from the front belt to her left hip. Both hands finish planted on her hips in an akimbo pose. She straightens her upper body and raises her chin slightly with a confident warm closed-mouth smile, corners of lips lifting. The loose ivory sleeves fold and flutter naturally as her arms move. The red cape gently swings in response to the gesture and settles. Hold the completed proud pose at the end. Preserve short black bob haircut, adult female facial identity, red cape, gold trim, ivory sleeves, black waistcoat, belt and hanging compass. Japanese tactical RPG cel-painted illustration, crisp hand-painted linework, flat warm gray background, fixed framing.
